title: Potassium & the ECG

findings.where: Source: potassium.jsx, PotassiumDiagram inline rendering when k <= 0; alternative-value versions of images 1 and 9
findings.title: Rejected values produce no visible recheck warning inline
findings.problem: For a supplied potassium of 0 or a negative number, classification returns "recheck", but the inline diagram merely removes the value marker and matched outline. The rejection message exists only in the SVG description and the final worked-step caption. A sighted student reading the rationale sees a picture indistinguishable from the intentional concept-only fallback, without knowing that the supplied result was rejected.
findings.fix: Render a visible invalid-result notice in the level group whenever state is "recheck", including the supplied value and the instruction to verify it. Keep the patient marker and matched outline suppressed.

findings.where: Source: kit.jsx, Gauge slide animation; potassium steps "range" and "worked" when played, corresponding to images 2, 8, 10 and 16
findings.title: The unchanged potassium value temporarily occupies the normal band
findings.problem: The whole value pin, including its numeric label, slides from the midpoint of the normal range to its actual position. With the example, a pin already reading 6.2 initially points at approximately 4.25. No change in potassium is being described, so the animation briefly contradicts the number-line meaning that the diagram is teaching. The settled screenshots conceal this.
findings.fix: Keep the marker at its computed position throughout playback and animate its opacity or emphasis instead of its horizontal position.

assessment: Two source-level presentation problems remain. The supplied still images do not show either problem.
